description: The new ASP.NET Core app that clients call, which serves migrated routes itself and forwards the rest.
The YARP direct-forwarding API that sends requests matching a route pattern to a fixed destination URL.
The endpoint priority set with `WithOrder`, which makes the catch-all fallback the last candidate after every local route.
A rule such as `{id:int}` that a route value must satisfy, so non-matching requests fall through to other endpoints.
A response header such as `X-Served-By` that lets tests and humans see which app answered a request.
Direct network access to the legacy app that bypasses the proxy, closed by binding the old app to a private address.
